serviceNames: 高尾登山電鉄ケーブルカー

source.note: All 38 published regular departures on Thursday 2026-12-10: December weekday service, 08:00 to 17:15 inclusive, every 15 minutes. Both terminals depart simultaneously. Departures are expanded from the official interval timetable; destination arrivals use the operator's approximate six-minute ride time, not separately published exact arrivals. The official page is available in the search index but the live timetable and home page redirect to a maintenance notice; December 2026 maintenance or extra-service notices could not be checked. Crowds can cause an earlier first departure or unscheduled extra trips; these have no published times and are not listed. The annual December schedule excludes New Year's Eve. Takaosan Station is below the summit; allow time to walk down to the cable station. The nearby chairlift uses different terminals (Sanjo and Sanroku) and operates continuously, 09:00 to 16:00 in December; it has no published discrete departures and is not represented by invented timetable rows.
